# Renew Clinical Care

Renew Clinical Care Ltd is a nurse-led postnatal healthcare company being developed in Bromley, London.

The proposed service will provide short-term support for mothers and babies at home following birth or hospital discharge. Renew Clinical Care is pre-launch and preparing for CQC registration. It is not currently providing, accepting or scheduling regulated care.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://renew-clinical-care.medjaybayek.chatgpt.site/): Overview of the proposed service and its pre-launch status.
- [About](https://renew-clinical-care.medjaybayek.chatgpt.site/about.html): Purpose, clinical leadership and development status.
- [Proposed services](https://renew-clinical-care.medjaybayek.chatgpt.site/services.html): Intended scope, suitability and exclusions.
- [For parents and carers](https://renew-clinical-care.medjaybayek.chatgpt.site/parents.html): Information for families considering future support.
- [For healthcare professionals](https://renew-clinical-care.medjaybayek.chatgpt.site/professionals.html): Proposed referral and handover pathway.
- [Frequently asked questions](https://renew-clinical-care.medjaybayek.chatgpt.site/faqs.html): Answers about the proposed service and current status.
- [Contact](https://renew-clinical-care.medjaybayek.chatgpt.site/contact.html): Preliminary, non-clinical enquiries only.

## Important safety information

This website is not an emergency or clinical advice service. Call 999 in an emergency. Use NHS 111 or contact the responsible maternity or clinical team for urgent advice, as appropriate.

Website enquiries must not include patient-identifiable information, NHS numbers, diagnoses, medical records or other clinical information.
